source_snapshot.procedure: Run AMD `dramecc --errormode 1 --address 0x1000 --enablemcapolling 0 --errortype 0` once after two ambiguous profiles.
source_snapshot.criteria: Tool PASS and corrected OS event within undefined timeout.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic ECC logs do not prove explicit-address routing.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires per-slot page translation, profile/tool semantics and cleanup.

old_problem: One unexplained 0x1000 value could be a system address, tool offset or invalid page and could not prove slot1~N; the DRAM/MCA profiles were not scoped.
disposition_reason: Explicit-address CE intent is clear and can be safely expressed with owner-supplied pinned pages and authoritative address translation. ED-03 treats actual addresses/topology as runtime bindings; ED-16 prohibits injection until the tool revision proves what `address` consumes. Both source profiles remain independent checkpoints unless a signed applicability decision excludes one, avoiding cumulative guessing or coverage loss.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 45, AI fields, historical record 2447 and next pending row 46.
Kept errormode1 explicit-address behavior distinct from row42 masked einjdramecc.
Preserved each populated slot and both profiles as separate evidence identities.
Rejected literal 0x1000 until the OS memory map, page ownership and platform decoder prove its meaning.
No page allocation, BIOS/HDT change or injection occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD explicit-address correctable DRAM ECC per slot
test_case.purpose: Validate errormode1 correctable explicit-address routing for every populated slot using a stable owned page and attributable corrected-event chain.
required_package: Populated UMC/channel/DIMM/rank topology and system-address decoder
Pinned owned test page per slot/profile with address semantics proof
AMD tool/spec hash/license for dramecc errormode1/mcapolling0/errortype0
Separate DRAM1.1 and MCA1.2 profile applicability
Address-specific OS/BMC oracle, timeout, cleanup and recovery
test_case.test_command: For one profile and target slot, reserve/pin a disposable page, prove the tool's address input and decode it through interleave/hash to that slot, then let the FAE run one signed errormode1 CE. Match transcript address, syndrome/location and OS/BMC evidence, verify memory health, release/clean the page and restore state before the next checkpoint.
test_case.expected_result: Every required slot/profile produces one correctable event tied to the supplied explicit address and physical location within timeout, without UCE, reset, poison persistence or memory-health regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an unbroken page→system-address→slot→event chain and complete matrix evidence. Literal 0x1000 without proof, generic ECC text, wrong slot, migrated page or incomplete cleanup cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated ECC SUT with OOB access and recoverable workload.
Pin and validate an owned backed page; never target reserved, firmware, MMIO or migrated memory.
One slot/profile only; abort on misrouting, UCE, storm, reset or health decline.
No retry; disable injector, clean/release page and restore settings.
expected_evidence: Profile/package provenance and exact address semantics
Full errormode1 command and address-specific event chain
Per-slot OS/BMC evidence and memory-health checks
Page cleanup, BIOS/HDT restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong-slot or severity behavior, stop, preserve address translation and event data, apply approved memory/poison recovery, disable injection, clean/release the page and restore the active profile before any new authorization.

source_conflict.reason: 0x1000 is no longer presumed universal; each slot/profile gets a proven pinned address and separate checkpoint.

blocked.reason: The test method and oracle are complete; address/tool details remain hard execution prerequisites.
